text:
ash: heads up — seeing repeated KV-cache burst patterns from tenant david-api in eu-west that correlate with GPU thermal climbs and egress spikes. latency tail creeping up for other tenants. anyone else seeing this?

 taylor: yep saw a few alerts 10m ago. KV miss rate shot to 85% for a short window, lots of small requests.

 ash: exact symptom: tiny chat requests that miss prefix cache, cause high KV RTT and then downstream qps spike to redis-proxy -> pcie saturation on node pool. CPU on sidecars also spikes.

 cj: can you paste the alert ids/hosts? I want to check whether it's hot on a few hosts or wide.

 ash: ops-bot posted the node alerts: 
```
ALERT: gpu_node_hot_spike node=eu-west-az3-rack11-nd-07
ALERT: kv_proxy_latency node=eu-west-az3-rack11-nd-07
```
Also saw neighbor tenant latencies rise ~120ms p50->p95 delta.

 taylor: query i ran (prom):
```
sum by(node) (increase(kv_proxy_requests_total[5m]))
/ sum by(node) (increase(kv_proxy_hits_total[5m]))
```
Shows a few nodes with 6x miss:hits compared to baseline.

 cj: suggests a quick guardrail: reduce route weight for overlay routing from shared pool to that rack, and bump canary to dedicated-slice for heavy tenant. fallback policy to smaller quantized model variants while we investigate.

 maria: cost note — moving heavy tenant to Dedicated incurs reserved-hour charges if >4h. can we do a short prewarm + soft-carve for 1h to confirm? cheaper than developer time chasing ephemeral noise.

 ash: agree on short soft-carve. proposed immediate mitigation steps below (quick):
1) add tenant david-api to soft-dedicated slice (ephemeral) for eu-west only
2) lower route weight from shared pools in az3 to 0.3 for that tenant
3) enable kv-prefetch hinting in sidecar for that tenant (experimental)
4) monitor p95 and thermal for 30m; rollback if no improvement

 taylor: how do we do step 1 via CLI?

 ash: CLI snippet: 
```
redwoodctl slices create --tenant david-api --region eu-west --type soft --duration 1h --gpu=2
redwoodctl routing adjust --tenant david-api --region eu-west --weight 0.3
```
(we've used that flow before)

 ops-bot: Deployment note — created ephemeral slice id=slice-ephem-944, reserved 2xA100 eu-west-az3, started warmup.

 cj: while warmup runs, can we also taint the noisy hosts to reduce new allocations from other tenants? apply k8s taint to nd-07 for 10m.

 maria: i can take the taint + canary traffic switch. tagging @taylor for monitoring. will note expected billing impact.

 taylor: i'll cut a dashboard panel for the next 45m: GPU thermal, KV RTT, p95 latency per-tenant, egress MB/s per-node. quick grafana query ready.

 ash: posted a short diag log showing request pattern: 
```
[2026-03-21T15:02:11Z] tenant=david-api req_size=48B model=chat-small prefix_hit=false kv_rtt=12ms
[2026-03-21T15:02:11Z] tenant=david-api req_size=32B model=chat-small prefix_hit=false kv_rtt=18ms
[2026-03-21T15:02:12Z] many small requests in 3s window -> kv proxy queue++
```

 cj: looks like fingerprint = lots of tiny, cache-unfriendly prefixes. long-term we should enforce rate-limited RPC coalescing or client-side batching for that tenant, but quick fix is the slice.

 maria: canary started: routing switched at 15:08. will monitor.

 taylor: graph shows p95 improving already on neighbors, kv_rtt down ~40% on overloaded nodes, GPU temps dropping ~4C. nice. :thumbsup:

 ash: rollback plan if things worsen: revert routing weights, drain ephemeral slice, and revert sidecar hinting.

 ops-bot: Alert resolved: gpu_node_hot_spike node=eu-west-az3-rack11-nd-07 cleared at 15:22Z

 maria: canary held for 20m, looks stable. i'll leave soft-dedicated for another 40m then tear down to avoid extra charges. documenting runbook steps in runbook ticket.

 taylor: postmortem action items: 1) add auto-detect fingerprint rule for high small-req miss-rate 2) auto-soft-carve playbook for short-lived noisy tenants 3) telemetry alert to include kv miss:hit ratio per-tenant 4) revisit pricing for 1h soft-dedicated bursts.

 ash: created ticket INFRA-1421 with those action items. thanks all. :heart:
